value.title: TestHub Blog | Revolutionizing Recruitment with Equality
value.description: Explore how TestHub is changing the game in recruitment with insights on minimizing hiring errors, securing top talent, and enhancing diversity. Read the latest on our blog.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Equality As A Standard.
Minimise hiring errors, secure top talent, and enhance diversity for organizational success.
Selected for the Katapult accelerator for impact startups.
Extreme tech challenge finalist in 2022
Testhub has assisted Malling & Co Forvaltning AS with several hires of Operations Managers. Testhub ensures that all candidates are treated equally and given equal opportunities in the hiring process. Testhub is an important contributor to our work to comply with the anti-discrimination legislation in Norway.– Albregt Moltumyr, Technical Director
A do it yourself recruitment tool based on 100 years of science.
Get an automated rating of all candidates based on their likelihood of success. Test candidates for traits that matter for work performance, and ensure everyone gets fair treatment with blind screening.
Easily integrate to your standard recruitment tool. Available in SAP Success Factors and TeamTailor.
Speed up your recruitment and reduce repetitive tasks.
Ensure fair treatment of all candidates
Ensure your recruitment process is up to date with local equal opportunity laws
We will email you only about this product.

pages.title: Meet Our Team | TestHub
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Meet the team behind Testhub.
The Testhub team is dedicated to ensure equal hiring practices and inclusive organizations
The team behind Testhub embody the core value of the product to a tee. We believe that equality should be a standard and everyone should deserve a fair chance.
Expert in human decision making and holds a master of science in Organizational Psychology and Leadership. DNV certified recruiter and bachelor’s in Marketing and Internalization Strategy.
He has been a key stakeholder in four tech startups and is a seasoned leader and business developer.
Testhubs technology is his brainchild based on his 15 year obsession with the research on human decision making.
Bjarte has over 13 years of experience in building software companies and driving product innovation. 
Having led startups as both CEO and product manager, he combines deep technical expertise with a keen understanding of market needs.
He brings expertise in identifying top technical talent and assessing candidates’ real-world problem-solving abilities. His technical insights ensure that organizations secure the best candidates for specialized roles.
Silje has a background in business and holds a double master of science degree in Business Analysis & Performance Management and a CEMS Masters’s in International Management. She has previously researched how large organisations can keep their innovative power.
For five years she has been working with recruitment at Testhub and has supported several companies in their recruitment processes.
She thrives in connecting the right people with the right opportunities, ensuring both individuals and organizations succeed. She is passionate about building diverse and high-performing teams.
